Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ لَا تَضُرُّكَ
Translation: O Lord, my sins do not harm You
And Your forgiveness to me does not diminish You
So grant me that which does not diminish You
And forgive me that which does not harm You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَكَ لِشَرِّ مَا عِنْدِيْ
Translation: O Allah, do not deprive me of the good that is with You because of the evil that is within me

Arabic text: فَإِنْ أَنْتَ لَمْ تَرْحَمْنِيْ بِتَعَبِيْ وَنَصَبِيْ
Translation: For if You do not have mercy on me despite my toil and exhaustion

Arabic text: فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ أَجْرَ الْمُصَابِ عَلَى مُصِيْبَتِهِ
Translation: Then do not deprive me of the reward of one afflicted for his calamity
